description: The programme closed on 2026-09-02 at finding F55. The validated result stands at 46-121M parameters: 96% of a conventional transformer's quality at equal compute with 2.70x fewer parameters. Taken to a billion parameters on web data, the tied arm failed its pre-registered 1B-token kill gate (perplexity ratio 1.56 vs 1.20) and was still closing at 2.5B tokens (1.31); both arms score at chance on public benchmarks, so the scale programme was halted rather than spent on a model no one would use. Everything shown here is pre-recorded from the record.
